AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL
  JANUARY 19, 2021
UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF THE
GOVERNOR'S EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20, N-29-20, AND N-35-20, WHICH ALLOWS MEETINGS TO BE
VIDEOCONFERENCED WITHOUT PROVIDING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS
DURING A MEETING, EITHER SEND AN EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov OR CALL (669) 900-
6833; MEETING ID: 709 573 2685; PASSCODE: 784059 DURING THE MEETING TO SPEAK ON AN ITEM
OR UNDER ORAL COMMUNICATIONS. THE MEETING MAY BE VIEWED ON FIOS CHANNEL 32 OR
CHARTER CHANNEL 3 OR ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT: https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-
agendas-393.
  6:00 PM
  VIDEOCONFERENCE
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Jennifer Perez, Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Vice Mayor
  Rick Ramirez, Councilmember
  Margarita L. Rios, Councilmember
  Ana Valencia, Councilmember
  Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, or through
  the video conference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction
  subject to the rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three
  minutes.

  Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
  certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain
  matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.

  Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Council:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
  meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk's Department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
  devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
  documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
  Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
  that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

  Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
  has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

  Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
  during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
  telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

  STUDY SESSION MEETING - 5:00 p.m.
 CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Perez

ROLL CALL

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR CLOSED SESSION MATTERS

CLOSED SESSION

  THREAT TO PUBLIC SERVICES OR FACILITIES – Consultation with the City Manager, Los Angeles
  County Sheriff representative, and other related City officials.

  II.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – ANTICIPATED LITIGATION PURSUANT  TO
  GOVERNMENT CODE §54956.9(d)(2) – Significant exposure to litigation in 1 case.

  III.  PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE §54957.6; CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR.
  Negotiating on behalf of the City: Jesus M. Gomez, City Manager; regarding negotiations with the
  Norwalk Association of Management Employees.

  IV.  CONFERENCE WITH REAL PROPERTY NEGOTIATOR PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE
  §54956.8: Assessor Parcel Number 8056-016-139; Negotiating on behalf of the City: Jesus M. Gomez,
  City Manager; Negotiating Party: Knights of Columbus; Under Negotiation: Price and Terms of

RECESS

CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Perez

  Councilmember Valencia

  Councilmember Rios

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

CITY COUNCIL COMMENTS

  a.  Report of City Council Travel

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS

  I.  City Council to recognize Angel Tree sponsors.

  II.  City Council to recognize the Light Up Norwalk winners.

  III.  City Council to recognize the 2021 Community Recycling Awareness Contest Winners.

CITY MANAGER COMMENTS

  1.  COVID-19 Update.

  2.  Chamber of Commerce Quarterly Report.
   3.  First Responders Toy Distribution event recap.

  4.  Las Posadas event recap.

  CLOSED SESSION REPORT

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll call vote.
Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by City Council.

  1.  MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meeting of
  December 15, 2020. 825-04

  Report

  2.  PAYROLL - Staff recommends City Council approve the gross payroll costs for the periods November
  15, 2020 - November 28, 2020, totaling $929,414.63; November 29, 2020 - December 12, 2020,
  totaling $880,074.20; and December 13, 2020 - December 26, 2020, totaling 1,001,477.37. 630

  Report

  3.  COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant registers for the
  periods December 9, 2020 through January 5, 2021, in the total amount of $4,487,707.91 and January
  6, 2021 through January 12, 2021, in the total amount of $1,308,427.63. 640

  Report

  4.  ORDINANCE NO. 20-1721 – AMENDING TITLE 2 OF THE NORWALK MUNICIPAL CODE –
  ELECTRONIC FILING OF CAMPAIGN DISCLOSURE DOCUMENTS AND STATEMENTS OF
  ECONOMIC INTERESTS - Staff recommends City Council accept for second reading and adopt
  Ordinance No. 20-1721, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF NORWALK ADDING CHAPTER 2.09 TO
  THE NORWALK MUNICIPAL CODE REGARDING CAMPAIGN DISCLOSURE DOCUMENTS AND
  STATEMENTS OF ECONOMIC INTERESTS. 865-04/05

  Report

APPOINTMENTS

  5.  ADVISORY BODIES – Staff recommends City Council make appointments to fill the vacancies on the
  various City advisory bodies. 200

  Report

REPORTS

  6.  ORDINANCE NO. 21-1722 - RECODIFICATION OF THE NORWALK MUNICIPAL CODE AND
  RESOLUTION NO. 21-01 ? PURCHASING POLICY ? Staff recommends City Council:

  a.  introduce for first reading by title only Ordinance No. 21-1722, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK, CALIFORNIA ADOPTING BY REFERENCE THE NORWALK MUNICIPAL CODE,
  (WHICH CODE CONSISTS OF TITLES 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 12, 13, 15, 16, 17, AND 18 OF
  THE NORWALK MUNICIPAL CODE ON FILE IN THE OFFICE OF THE NORWALK CITY
  CLERK), WHICH CODE ADOPTS THE FOLLOWING SECONDARY CODES BY REFERENCE:
  DIVISION 1, HEALTH CODE, OF TITLE 11 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE; DIVISION
  1, PUBLIC HEALTH LICENSES, OF TITLE 8 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE; THE LOS
  ANGELES COUNTY VEHICLES AND TRAFFIC CODE (THE COUNTY TRAFFIC ORDINANCE)
  AS ADOPTED, AMENDED AND IN EFFECT ON FEBRUARY 13, 1981; THE LOS ANGELES
  COUNTY CODE, TITLE 32, 2002 FIRE CODE; DIVISION 2, SANITARY SEWERS AND
  INDUSTRIAL WASTE, OF TITLE 20 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE; PART 2 OF TITLE
  24 OF THE CALIFORNIA CODE OF REGULATIONS, INCLUDING THE APPENDICES,
  COMPRISING THE 2019 CALIFORNIA BUILDING CODE; PART 5 OF TITLE 24 OF THE
   CALIFORNIA CODE OF REGULATIONS, INCLUDING THE APPENDICES, COMPRISING THE
  2019 CALIFORNIA PLUMBING CODE; PART 3 OF TITLE 24 OF THE CALIFORNIA CODE OF
  REGULATIONS, INCLUDING THE APPENDICES COMPRISING THE 2019 CALIFORNIA
  ELECTRICAL CODE; PART 4 OF TITLE 24 OF THE CALIFORNIA CODE OF REGULATIONS,
  INCLUDING THE APPENDICES, COMPRISING THE 2019 CALIFORNIA MECHANICAL CODE;
  AND PART 10 OF TITLE 24 OF THE CALIFORNIA CODE OF REGULATIONS, COMPRISING
  APPENDIX 1 OF THE 2019 CALIFORNIA CODE FOR BUILDING CONSERVATION, and waive
  further reading; and

  b.  set a public hearing for February 2, 2021; and

  c.  adopt Resolution No. 21-01, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK INSTITUTING A REVISED PURCHASING POLICY FOR THE CITY’S PURCHASING
  PROGRAM PURSUANT TO CHAPTER 3.16 “PURCHASING SYSTEM” OF TITLE 3 “REVENUE
  AND FINANCE” OF THE NORWALK MUNICIPAL CODE. 634/860

  Report

  NMC update_01-19-21

  7.  AMENDMENT TO PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AND SOFTWARE LICENSE AGREEMENT FOR
  MAINTENANCE AND SUPPORT OF COMPUTER AIDED DISPATCH / RECORDS MANAGEMENT
  SYSTEM - Staff recommends City Council approve an amendment to the agreement with Cyrun in the
  form of Change Order NPS_120420-01 for maintenance and support of a computer aided
  dispatch/records management system extending the term through November 14, 2023 with an
  automatic renewal every three years; and authorize the City Manager to execute the change order, on
  behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 634-04

  Report

  8.  PROJECT NO. 7438R – REJECT BIDS - ADVANCED METERING INFRASTRUCTURE (AMI)
  SYSTEM INSTALLATION PROJECT – PHASE 2 – Staff recommends City Council reject all bids for
  Project No. 7438R – Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) System Installation Project – Phase 2.
  1005-04-7438R

  Report

  9.  RESOLUTION NO. 21-02 - BUDGET AMENDMENT – PRINTING AND MAILING OF COMMUNITY
  NEWSLETTER - Staff recommends City Council adopt Resolution No. 21-02, A RESOLUTION OF
  THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE
  FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 ADOPTED BUDGET TO APPROPRIATE FUNDS FOR PRINTING AND
  MAILING OF COMMUNITY NEWSLETTER, in the amount of $81,000. 145-03

  Report

  10. NORWALK BICYCLE MASTER PLAN – Staff recommends City Council receive and file this report.
  1005-04-7855

  Report

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated January 15, 2021.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk
